DEV-001.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a := by simpa using Nat.add_comm a b

DEV-002.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b : Nat) : a * b = b * a := by simpa using Nat.mul_comm a b

DEV-003.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (p q : Prop) : p ∧ q ↔ q ∧ p := by simpa using and_comm

DEV-004.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (p q : Prop) : p ∨ q ↔ q ∨ p := by simpa using or_comm

DEV-005.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b c : Int) : a + b + c = a + (b + c) := by simpa using add_assoc a b c

DEV-006.proofSource:
import Mathlib
example (a b c : Int) : a * b * c = a * (b * c) := by simpa using mul_assoc a b c
